prompt: Origin: the photo of Enigma, the robot built for the World Championship, raised on its linear-rail lift outdoors under a flowering cherry tree, from the cover of the team's Worlds DECODE engineering portfolio (public Canva view https://canva.link/23511worlds2026port, page 1, rendered at 2200x2848 on 2026-09-27).
